font.formatting: Ideal glyph drawing; Display title/detail layout; Ideal counter measurement
font.trayBackend: native Windows HMENU via .NET Framework ContextMenu; no private menu font registration
font.systemManagedUI: tray context menu, notification-area tooltip, balloon tips and system message boxes

sampling.motion: reuse 4x source with WPF HighQuality image scaling
sampling.static: final physical pixels with NearestNeighbor; no intentional rescaling
sampling.cache: per-toast shared pixel workspace; reusable per-control high/final surfaces; empty drawing and erased pixels when hidden

font.counterWidthFix: untrimmed glyphs are unconstrained single-line; no rounded-width wrapping or tight explicit clipping; 4x retained
font.verticalInkBounds: expand sampled image and vertical clip to real glyph outlines plus physical safety padding; preserve layout and baseline

implementation.backend: Windows.UI.Composition host backdrop + native Gaussian effect + WPF tint/noise/text
implementation.materialWindow: native HWND without WPF target or GDI background brush
implementation.materialOrdering: text HWND is an owned window permanently above material owner
implementation.positioning: no z-order changes; skip unchanged bounds; idempotent show/hide

copyFeedback.visibleCard: first keyboard copy has no new pulse; repeat count >= 2 pulses visible copy feedback
copyFeedback.hiddenCard: actual result with fade only; no pulse even if burst count carries over
copyFeedback.titleResponse: prepare immediately at key event; select success text only after confirmed result
copyFeedback.rapidSecondKeyBeforeFirstFrame: second key may queue a pulse; initial key alone never queues one

titleTransition.copySignal: start at keyboard dispatch before clipboard result
titleTransition.slowSource: fade the last verified title back in; never show premature success

paletteSource: CCCC adaptation approved by user; not an official Apple notification RGB specification

statusIcons.successVariant: swap the original 2.3.2 background and symbol colors within each theme
statusIcons.colorSource: original CCCC 2.3.2 palette, swapped literally; no new colors

trayMenu.backend: WinForms ContextMenu and MenuItem wrapping native HMENU; OwnerDraw=false
trayMenu.darkAdaptation: optional process-local uxtheme exports 135/136; minimum build 18362; system native appearance fallback when unavailable

checkedItems.startup: checked from actual current-user Run registration
checkedItems.material: checked when user allows material; system policy can still disable it

trayMenu.popupRefresh: pause, preview, startup, material preference and theme
trayMenu.startupOtherLocation: keeps checked state and adds a label suffix

memoryOptimizationRound1.budgetScope: known raw text pixel buffers/surfaces only, not process or GPU memory

materialPreference.label: 高级材质
materialPreference.disableAction: detach owner; dispose native material window, compositor, target, effects and geometry

presentationPreparation.startEpoch: first rendering callback after layout, background, visible glyphs and material positioning are ready
presentationPreparation.pendingUpdates: latest current content only; hide/close cancel pending flags
presentationPreparation.fadeOutInterruptedByCopy: resume from current opacity with smoothstep over 200 * (1-opacity) ms
